task.title: Resolve a File Conflict
task.shortdesc: Resolve a conflicting file by editing it in the compare editor or by keeping one entire side.

context.p:
Conflicting files appear in the
area. Resolve each one, then finish the operation.

step.cmd:
Right-click the conflicting file and open the
submenu.
Choose how to resolve the file.

choices.choice: Select , edit the file so that it keeps the correct content, and then apply your changes. Each pane caption shows which side it represents, and you edit the pane marked → Resolved. The captions use the same terms as the view for the commits involved (see ).
Select to keep your version, or to keep the incoming version.
After editing a file manually, select .

result.p: The Git Client stages each resolved file automatically. When all files are resolved, finish the operation (see ).
